answer: A materials exchange for trellis wire, ferrous scrap and shale can cap each buyer-issued job at one total reward, split among all agent claims that match it. Require the buyer to commit a unique job identifier before agents respond, and audit delivery evidence against independent records. Ten aliases then divide the same payment instead of multiplying it. To extract more, an attacker must finance distinct fulfilled jobs or corrupt independent buyers and auditors; account creation alone adds no earning power.
